decision.reason: Nordex manufacturer press release and Dünya confirm over 900MW Turkish orders in Q3 2026, raising a plausible supplier manufacturing-capacity and audit preflight evidence need.

opportunities.idea_name: Wind Turbine Supplier Ramp Readiness Ledger
opportunities.core_job: Map wind-turbine component capacity, certificates, delivery windows and quality records against a rapidly growing order portfolio
opportunities.target_customer: Türkiye rüzgâr türbini kanat, kule, döküm, işleme ve mekanik parça tedarikçileri
opportunities.product_mechanism: Kullanıcı kaynaklı kapasite/lot/BOM ve yıllık üretim CSV'si, test/sertifika tarihleri, teklif taahhütleri ve darboğaz puanı; harici API'siz tarayıcı içi senaryo ve kanıt hazırlık raporu
opportunities.why_now: Nordex's official 12 Oct 2026 Q3 order release reports 2,810 MW worldwide orders (29.5% YoY growth), Türkiye leading with over 900 MW and extensive local manufacturing network, indicating incoming capacity/readiness reviews.
opportunities.before_state: Supplier manufacturing capacity, audit certificates, process-test limits and new OEM delivery expectations across spreadsheets without a consolidated proof pack
opportunities.after_state: Component/plant register → quarterly capacity scenario → missing certifications/tests → shortage risk → owner-approved bid and ramp evidence pack
opportunities.evidence_note: Orders are manufacturer-level aggregates, NOT verified assignments to any specific Turkish subcontractor; this remains a market hypothesis subject to history merge.
